title: Apples iOS 27 and Siri AI are coming soon: Everything we know so far
content:
Apple's iOS 27 and Siri AI are coming soon: Everything we know so far
Apple's most important software platform is about to get a big upgrade.
In a couple weeks, Apple will finally launch the iOS 27. Yes, we've seen and tried out the developer betas and the public betas. Right now, we're at Developer Beta 7 and Public Beta 5; this late in the game, we don't expect to see any major new features when iOS 27 launches properly, though surprises are always possible. The keynote event is called "Surprise and shine," after all.
For most users, however, the iOS 27 that launches next month is the new version, as most folks don't bother (and they shouldn't) installing the public beta. So, here's everything we've learned from testing iOS 27, which includes the Siri AI beta, and a list of the hottest new features to try out when it launches.
You May Also Like
Guess what Apple will release in September in our Big Guessing Game: Apple edition. Enter now for a chance to win an Apple Watch!
When is iOS 27 arriving?
The final version of iOS 27 is likely to arrive mid-September. More precisely, given that Apple is launching new iPhones on Sept. 9, we'll probably get iOS 27 a week later, on Sept. 16 (give or take a day or two).
If you're still eager to try out the latest beta (which is bound to be very similar to the final release), here's how to do that and what you can expect from it.
Who gets to install iOS 27?
Apple's iOS 27 will be available for iPhone 11 and later, as well as iPhone SE (2nd generation and later). Also, Apple's upcoming iPhones, which are reportedly iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max, and the foldable iPhone Ultra, will almost certainly run iOS 27 out of the box.
How to install iOS 27?
If you have a compatible device (see above), the process will consist merely of going to your iPhone's Settings, General, Software Update, and choosing to install the new OS. The process should take roughly 10 minutes (depending on your internet connection).
It's always wise to back up your phone before updating your software, though in this case, we don't expect any major problems; Apple's final, major software releases tend to be fairly polished.
What's new in iOS 27
There are a lot of new features in iOS 27, with the crown jewel among them being improved Siri (which is now called Siri AI), as well as Apple Intelligence, both of which permeate the device's many features and built-in apps, offering new, simpler ways to achieve everyday tasks.
Besides that, the Liquid Glass interface has been updated with more customizability, numerous apps, including Safari, Reminders, Notes, Photos, and Health, have gotten new features, and the iPhone, overall, should perform better.
The new features range from major changes to tiny aesthetic improvements. Apple's got an overview here; below, here's our choice of the best new features you should try after installing iOS 27.
A word of caution: Some of the AI features aren't available in the EU due to Apple's dispute over AI with European regulators. There's currently no timeline as to when this could be resolved. With that out of the way, here are the best 7 iOS 27 features you should try after installing it.
Siri AI
If you're in the U.S., Siri AI will work for you, and you can access it by either uttering the "Hey Siri" voice command, pressing and holding the iPhone's side button, or swiping down from the Dynamic Island on top of your screen.
Once it's activated, you can use it to search for documents, emails, and photos on your device, ask it questions about a website on your screen (or any sort of general questions), get recommendations for places and activities, and easily create home automations.
Siri understands you, personally, as it can draw context from your emails and other documents. It also knows a lot about the world, making it similar to LLMs such as OpenAI, so you can ask it questions or give it tasks related to you, personally, or just ask it about any topic you like.
For a detailed overview of Siri's new features, go here and here.
Visual Intelligence
Unfortunately, the same caveat goes for this one: It's not available in the EU at launch.
It's a pity, because it's a cool feature that lets you point your camera at things and get information about them from Siri. This includes splitting a restaurant bill, getting working hours for a business, figuring out which plant or animal you're looking at, and more.
You can access Visual Intelligence by clicking and holding the Camera Control button, or (if you have an iPhone that doesn't have the Camera Control button) either through Control Center or by customizing the Action button or Lock Screen.
Child Safety
Every parent knows what a nightmare the parental control features can be. You think you've set up everything right, only to discover that your kid still has unlimited access to YouTube (and is using it without any limits whatsoever).
In iOS 27, Apple has overhauled the Child Safety features with an easier setup, more granular control over apps and websites, and better screen time management. The Communication Safety feature can even intervene before a child sees gore or violence in videos and images shared over Messages and FaceTime.
There are detailed options for time allowances across several categories, including Entertainment, Games, and Social Media. Perhaps most importantly, there are now simple controls to either fully pause device use, or allow unlimited use of a device.
Updates to Messages, Mail, Calendar, Safari
Siri's new smarts extend over a number of Apple's built-in apps.
For example, in Messages as well as Mail, Siri can write things for you based on a description, and the result will match your style. Both those apps will also offer suggestions based on your conversations, such as adding events to your Calendar or a reminder to your Reminders app.
Safari has also gotten smarter. It will automatically group your tabs into topics, and a particularly cool new feature called Notify Me can monitor a webpage for changes, sending you an alert when it detects something new on the page.
Better photo editing
Apple has been way behind when it comes to AI-assited photo editing. Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones have a full suite of image editing tools that work really well. With iOS 27, Apple is finally catching up to its Android competition.
The new, AI-enhanced photo editing tools are a pretty cool way to fix your photos, even some of the ones that came out quite poorly. The three new tools, available under "Tools" when you start editing a photo, include Clean Up, which lets you remove unwanted objects with a tap or a gesture. The Extend tool will automagically add content around the borders using AI, and Reframe lets you adjust the perspective of a photo.
Smarter Shortcuts
I don't know a lot of people who use Shortcuts on iPhone, probably because the idea of manually setting up a chain of actions for your phone sounds pretty tricky to do.
In iOS 27, however, Apple has simplified this by adding the option to describe the shortcut and have it created automatically. To access it, open Shortcuts and tap New Shortcut, and just describe what you want the Shortcut to do. Stuff like "Turn the lights on, turn on Do Not Disturb, and start playing my favorite album" should work.
New Image Playground
Yeah, another thing that's absent in the EU. If you have it, it's a cool one. Image Playground was actually there before, in iOS 26, but the images it could generate were mostly cartoons or simple illustrations. Now, you can get photorealistic images, too.
If you don't like your result, you can fine-tune it by adding additional prompts, with the option to precisely mark the part of the image that you want changed.
Liquid Glass adjustments
This is a small one, but it's important to a lot of folks. Under Settings and Appearances, you can now set exactly how clear or tinted you want your "liquified" apps and UI elements in iOS 27 to be.

report.summary: 苹果iOS 27即将发布，Siri AI与多项新功能亮相，部分AI功能欧盟不可用。
report.background: 苹果将在9月推出iOS 27，目前正处于开发者Beta 7和公测Beta 5阶段。作为苹果最重要的软件升级，iOS 27以Siri AI为核心，深度整合Apple Intelligence，并带来视觉智能、儿童安全、照片编辑等新特性。不过由于与欧盟监管机构的争议，部分AI功能在欧盟暂不可用，且暂无解决时间表。新系统预计9月16日左右正式推送，支持iPhone 11及后续机型。
key_points: Siri AI成为核心，能理解个人上下文和世界知识，支持设备内搜索、网页问答、推荐和家庭自动化，美国用户可用。
视觉智能通过摄像头识别物体、餐厅账单等，操作便捷，但欧盟用户暂时无法使用该功能。
儿童安全功能全面革新，简化家长控制设置，可精细管理应用和网站，并能在暴力内容显示前进行干预。
内置应用升级明显：Siri可在邮件和短信中代写内容，Safari自动分组标签页并监控页面变化。
照片编辑引入AI清理、扩展和重新构图工具，快捷指令支持自然语言描述自动生成，降低了使用门槛。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，苹果将大模型能力无缝融入系统，强化了端侧智能和隐私保护，可能推动竞品加速跟进。开发者需适配Siri AI和视觉智能接口，同时留意欧盟市场合规差异。普通用户将获得更自然、主动的助手体验和更安全的儿童防护，但欧盟用户暂时无法享受部分AI功能，形成体验落差。
report.tools: 可关注Apple Developer Program下载Beta版进行体验，或使用iOS内置的Shortcuts、Image Playground等工具。开发者可查阅苹果AI框架文档，也可参考OpenAI API或本地LLM开源项目（如Ollama）来了解类似能力。
